# Release binary pins for .github/actions/release-bin (S273, AA-1024):
#   "<tool> <version> <x86_64|aarch64> <sha256 of the release file> <release file url> <member to install | ->"
# One version per tool, one line per runner platform. Each sha256 was checked on 08/11/2026 against the file downloaded
# with an authenticated `gh release download` AND the release's own checksums file (syft_<v>_checksums.txt,
# trivy_<v>_checksums.txt, actionlint_<v>_checksums.txt, oasdiff checksums.txt). The Session Manager plugin has no
# checksums file (AWS signs it): its pin is the sha256 of the versioned .deb, the same bytes as plugin/latest that day.
# To move a pin: change every line of the tool together, in every repo that carries this file, in one wave.
